title: God of War: Laufey Game Launch and Connection to Upcoming Kratos Chapter
description: The upcoming God of War game, Laufey, is set to launch in 2027, with a direct connection to the next Kratos-led chapter.

sections.heading: God of War Laufey Release Date
paragraphs: The release date for the God of War Laufey game has been announced for 2027, as reported by The Times of India.

sections.heading: Connection to Next Kratos Chapter
paragraphs: IGN reports that the next Kratos-led God of War game is coming after Laufey and will connect directly to her story, as revealed at Comic Con 2026.

sections.heading: PlayStation Launch
paragraphs: The Economic Times confirms the PlayStation launch of God of War Laufey and teases the next chapter involving Kratos.

faq.q: What is the release date of God of War Laufey?
faq.a: According to The Times of India, the release date for God of War Laufey is set for 2027.

faq.q: Is there a connection between God of War Laufey and the next Kratos game?
faq.a: Yes, IGN states that the next Kratos-led God of War game will connect directly to Laufey's story.
